head: claude/mi107-downgrade-and-tune
title: MI-107: the demote-to-shadow-and-tune flow, exit condition first
body:
## Summary

The operator rejected the whole retire / do-not-retire axis on 2026-09-03 and asked for a third path: **demote to shadow and tune, not turn things off outright.** This writes that flow (`docs/design/strategy-demote-and-tune-DESIGN.md`) and records the operator's actual answer against the ten sunset candidates. **Nothing is retired, nothing is demoted, and no `execution:` value changes** — every move the flow describes is Tier-3 and is proposed only.

**(c) was built first, as the brief required, and it is bounded on the TUNING BUDGET rather than the outcome.** That is the load-bearing choice: `strategy_gate.py::GateThresholds.min_live_trades` is 30 and a 1d equity leg trades ~4 times a year, so an outcome-keyed exit condition is ~7.5 years — never met by construction. The reader is `scripts/ops/sunset_pass.py` on its **existing** weekly cron; at budget expiry the row **cannot stay demoted** and is forced to `promote_proposed` or `retire_proposed`, reusing the carry-escalation shape `SUNSET-DISPOSITIONS.json` already has. No new register, no new guard, and **no third execution gate** — the flow rides `execution: shadow`.

**The finding: none of the ten candidates qualifies for the flow.** Measured over `comms/sunset/2026-09-01/INDEX.json` joined to `config/strategies.yaml` on 2026-09-04 — all ten have `lifetime_closed_trades: 0`, and **not one is routed to real money** (every routing is paper). So no money is at risk to protect and there is no behaviour to tune. Worse, `execution: shadow` folds into `effective_dry` on *every* account **including paper**, so demoting them would stop their paper fills and make the exit condition strictly harder to meet. They are not underperforming — they are **not running**. Hence the third disposition the data forced: **`REPAIR`**, where the diagnosis is the work, not the parameters.

The shadow-backlog this design guards against is **not hypothetical**: 8 of 52 enabled legs are already `execution: shadow`, and `turtle_soup` has been shadow since **2026-04-29** — four months, zero closes, routed to zero accounts — surfacing only because a different mechanism eventually flagged it.

## Architecture impact

- [x] **Not applicable** — docs and decision records only. No data schema, model boundary, pipeline stage, deployment stage, runtime responsibility, public API, inter-process contract, or configuration shape changes. `config/strategies.yaml` is not touched.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3 scripts/ci/run_guards.py --base main` — **PASS 49 · FAIL 0**, all relevant guards green (`pytest` installed first, so a missing runner is not graded as a failing test; committed first, so the ~17 uncommitted-tree guards actually ran).
- [x] `check_backlog_refs.py` caught a **real** defect on the first run — a truncated `BL-...-4-PER-YEAR...` id that resolved to nothing — fixed with full ids, then green.
- [x] `check_sunset_dispositions.py` green: the ten are `keep` with a `reason` and a future `review_by` (2026-11-03), so the keep still expires rather than becoming a permanent exemption.
- [x] Work object and `MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json` re-parsed after edit; both registers round-trip byte-identically at `indent=2`.
- [ ] CI green

## Filed for follow-ups

- **Operator agreement is the gate and has NOT been given.** `DEC-20260904-DEMOTE-AND-TUNE-FLOW` is a `decision_requests[]` block on `WO-20260903-SUNSET-DISPOSITIONS-OWED`, so the item is genuinely waiting on the operator once this lands on `main`.
- **The budget-expiry forced disposition is DESIGNED, NOT BUILT.** `sunset_pass.py` does not yet implement it; that build follows agreement and is deliberately not reported as shipped.
- The `REPAIR` diagnosis for the ten is unfunded session work — that is the second half of the decision request.
